biography.value:
Description

These giants resemble twisted dwarves made huge. They are masters of metallurgy and military tactics.

Defense

AC 24, touch 8, flat-footed 24 (+8 armor, -1 dex, +8 natural, -1 size)

hp 142 [192] (15d8+75)

Fort +14, Ref +4, Will +9

Defensive Abilities Rock Catching

Immune Fire

Resist Earth 15, ice 50%

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 40 ft., (30 ft. in armor)

Melee Greatsword +21/+16/+11 (3d6+15/19-20) or 2 Slams +20 (1d8+10)

Ranged Rock +10 (1d8+15 plus 1d6)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Earthquake, Fire Roar, Heated Rock, Rock Throwing (120 ft.)

Statistics

Str 31, Dex 9, Con 21, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 11

Base Atk +11; CMB +22; CMD 31

Feats Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Overrun, Improved Sunder, Iron Will, Martial Weapon Proficiency (greatsword), Power Attack, Weapon Focus (greatsword)

Skills Climb +14, Intimidate +17, Perception +14

Languages Common, Giant

Combat Gear half-plate, greatsword

description.value: Special attack listed in the source statblock: Rock Throwing (120 ft.).
Once per round with awareness and a free hand, catch an incoming Small, Medium or Large rock with a Reflex save DC 15, 20 or 25, respectively.

Once every 1d2 rounds, a fire gigas can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 19) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).
